customManagers.description: k3s version pinned in the system-upgrade-controller Plans. Dependabot cannot cover this: the version lives in `version:`, not in an `image:` tag, and rancher/k3s-upgrade is deliberately untagged.

Validation tool versions pinned in the CI workflow — env vars and setup-action inputs. Dependabot's github-actions ecosystem only bumps `uses:` refs, so without this the pins go stale silently and CI drifts from what a developer runs locally. The Flux CLI pin is intentionally excluded: it tracks what the clusters run, not the newest release.

Image tags pinned inside a HelmRelease's values, used where a chart lags its own application. Neither of the built-in managers sees these: the flux manager reads `spec.chart.spec.version`, and Dependabot's docker ecosystem needs a full `image: repo:tag`, not a bare `tag:` under an `image:` map.
